purpose: Pin and validate external room-correction optimization and DSP-execution references without making either project an Aurora runtime dependency.

camilladsp.dependency_lock_policy: upstream pin has no Cargo.lock; CI generates one from the exact pinned Cargo.toml, records its SHA-256, then executes with --locked

next_evidence: deterministic synthetic multichannel RoomEQ optimization scenario
RoomEQ-to-CamillaDSP export preservation and execution differential
truth_boundary: This baseline validates exact external source identities, licensing boundaries, required optimizer/executor surfaces and selected upstream tests only. The selected DSP-realization regression is required to execute exactly one named upstream test rather than accepting a zero-test filter. The pinned CamillaDSP source does not publish Cargo.lock, so CI records the generated dependency-lock SHA-256 for each run before executing with --locked; this is an auditable run closure, not an upstream-published dependency pin. It is not a room measurement, not an Aurora acoustic correction result, not physical loudspeaker evidence, not measured latency, and not proof that RoomEQ-generated DSP is preserved by CamillaDSP until a separate export/execution differential passes.
